title: Nothing can be dropped on an inactive or unenrolled technician
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 20 minutes.
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011).
  • [User-A] = you: an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch the Admin quick-login user, shown as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit.
  • Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide. Narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher.
  • One location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); everything below is created in this location.
  • Three technicians: [Tech-A] "Esther Howard" and [Tech-B] "Ralph Edwards", eligible at this location, and [Tech-C], a technician used only by this case. A person only counts as a technician here when the staff member is active (not deactivated), Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Inactive Drop" (used by this case only) with three Approved work orders: [WO-1] led by [Tech-A], [WO-2] led by [Tech-B], [WO-3] led by [Tech-C].
  • After the work orders were created: [Tech-A]'s staff record is Inactive; [Tech-C] is still Active but no longer enrolled at this location.
  • This case changes a shared staff record (Esther Howard): run it when no other case is using her, and afterwards set her record Active again.
  • Esther Howard and Ralph Edwards are named in the expected results and stay as written; [Tech-C]'s name and the numbers are examples.

Setup

  1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders).
  2. Use one location for the whole case: it is shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location.
  3. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: reuse a technician only after checking it is active, has Time Clock on, a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User and this location in Location; otherwise add one: New Staff Member > First Name and Last Name, an Email, Role "Technician", at least one Department (required), Location = this location, Time Clock on > Save & Close. Record them as [Tech-A] = "Esther Howard" (use exactly this name: the expected results name it), [Tech-B] = "Ralph Edwards" (use exactly this name: the expected results name it), [Tech-C] (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST F1 Dana Unenrolled).
  4. Create the customer used only by this case: top menu Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Inactive Drop" > Save. On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, unit "TRK-118") > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty.
  5. Create these work orders for "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Inactive Drop": Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and its Asset > Save. The new work order opens with the New Line form (otherwise click New Line on the Lines tab): in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"; typed free text finds no results), turn on Line Approved so the work order status reads Approved, and click Save & Close. Write down the number the build gives the work order (on a QA branch they look like "S10043-17581"). Then pick the lead in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page; it saves at once. (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.) Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned.
    • [WO-1] (e.g. S1-702): Lead Technician = [Tech-A].
    • [WO-2] (the expected results call it "S1-698"): Lead Technician = [Tech-B].
    • [WO-3] (e.g. S1-691): Lead Technician = [Tech-C].
  6. Deactivate [Tech-A]: Settings > Staff > [Tech-A] > set the record Inactive > Save.
  7. Un-enrol [Tech-C] from this location (Settings > Staff > [Tech-C] > remove this location > Save); she stays Active.
  8. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > Search "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Inactive Drop" shows [WO-1] led by [Tech-A], [WO-2] led by [Tech-B] and [WO-3] led by [Tech-C]; Settings > Staff shows [Tech-A] Inactive and [Tech-C] Active without this location. If not, fix the lead or staff record before starting; then clear the search.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and pick Board View in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar; tooltip "Board View").
  2. Type "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Inactive Drop" in Search.
  3. Find [Tech-A]'s column and [Tech-C]'s column (they stay because they lead matching work) and read their headers.
  4. Drag [WO-2] from [Tech-B]'s column onto [Tech-A]'s column.
  5. Drag [WO-2] onto [Tech-C]'s column.
  6. Repeat steps 4 and 5 in Tech View on the groups.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Esther Howard's column/group is still shown with her work order and is marked inactive.
  • Neither drop is accepted: "S1-698" returns to Ralph Edwards' column and its lead stays Ralph Edwards. The same happens in Tech View.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S4-N5, read 8 Oct 2026. S2-N2/S3-N2 (deactivated lead keeps matching work visible). PO answer to engineering, Sasha Grosman 24 Sep 2026: technicians who are active but no longer eligible here are treated like inactive. Source-verified 8 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-N5: “Nothing can be dropped onto an inactive technician's column/group (S2-N2, S3-N2).”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.
